# Shadow League Fighting — changelog

Shadow League Fighting's ROM sets ship with the NeoGeoSDK pre-releases and
are numbered on their own: `_v2` with v1.7.5.

## v2 (2026-10-13, NeoGeoSDK v1.7.5 pre-release) — The 44-Fighter Chimera Expansion

### The game

- Complete 44-Fighter Tournament Roster:
  - 32 Main Tournament Competitors from 32 distinct countries.
  - 7 Bonus Contenders (Lotus, El Toro Rojo, Irina, Kofi, Xiao Mei, etc.).
  - 2 Hidden Masters (Zero, Echo).
  - 3 Project Chimera Prototype Droids (Atlas, Viper, Mirage).
- 44 custom 32x32 arcade character select portraits with native fighter palettes.
- Windowed Character Select Screen:
  - Intuitive navigation across all 44 combatants (Left/Right step, Up/Down column jump).
  - Live animated preview of chosen fighter in neutral and victory stances.
  - Independent 1P and 2P cursor tracking and palette-matched indicators.
- Multi-Arena Stages:
  - Arata Mountain Dojo (Japan)
  - Bangkok Night Stadium (Thailand)
  - Brooklyn Underground Gym (USA)
  - Project Chimera Facility - The Veil Core
  - Real-time stage switching, parallax scrolling (near 512x224 and far 512x160 layers), and dynamic 8-bank palette loading.
- Attract Mode Presentation:
  - Atmospheric Prologue: "The Veil - Project Chimera" storyline crawl.
  - "How To Play" tutorial demonstration detailing 4-button arcade inputs, tactical rolls (A+B), blowback counters (C+D), and special/super execution.
  - Champion Roster Showcase highlighting fighters, countries, and styles.
  - Interactive CPU demo bouts.
- 8-Stage Arcade Ladder & Epilogue:
  - Face 5 global contenders, 1 rival bout, 1 sub-boss droid (Atlas/Viper), and the final boss (Mirage).
  - Climactic story epilogue and victory presentation upon tournament completion.

### Hardware & Graphics

- C-ROM utilization optimized to 64,528 tiles, remaining strictly within the 65,536 (16-bit) hardware indexing budget without bankswitching latency.
- Verified in MAME (MVS and AES) with open EagleBIOS.
